uncertainty: Report counts and uncertainty intervals. Do not describe model agreement as human gold accuracy.

provisional_engineering_gate.rule: A module can be proposed for a named descriptive use only if its own gate passes overall and no reported period has a material systematic failure. Complex unresolved paths remain unknown.

comparative_release_rule: In addition to the provisional module gate, estimated measurement-error changes across compared periods must be small relative to a minimum detectable effect frozen before parser results; the MDE cannot be chosen after seeing results.

cohort_separation.formally_validated: Only variables passing human/adjudicated sealed-test criteria for the named use and period.
cohort_separation.historical_time: Not released; delivery text has no verified historical effective timestamp.

quarter_rule: 2026Q2 is the last complete natural quarter; 2026Q3 is partial.
sealed_test_rule: Do not inspect sealed-test text or predictions until calibration-driven changes are frozen. This is workflow separation, not a cryptographic seal.
